tcp_definition.definition: midpoint between symmetric finger pad centers
tcp_definition.axes: Same as tool0; confirmed initial posture X down, Y horizontal, Z forward. Finger closing axis is approximately tool Y.
tcp_definition.candidate_frame_conversion: For existing abstract candidates (X closing, Y up, Z approach), R_world_tcp = R_world_candidate @ Rz(-pi/2); candidate position is the grasp_tcp position.

scope: Pose IK only; iteration trace is NOT a validated motion trajectory. No base navigation, collision avoidance or grasp physics.
